data.one_liner: A robust, type-safe Dart client for Valkey and Redis-compatible servers.
data.what_it_does: It enables Dart applications to connect to Valkey or Redis servers, execute commands, manage Pub/Sub messaging, and interact with JSON modules with type safety.
use_when: You need to connect a Dart or Flutter backend/client to Valkey or Redis.
You require Pub/Sub messaging support over Redis/Valkey.
You are working with RedisJSON modules and need typed document stores.
avoid_when: You are looking for an on-device embedded SQL or key-value storage database like SQLite or SharedPreferences.
strengths: Supports SSL certificate management including bad certificate callbacks.
Automatic reconnection with exponential backoff and auto-resubscribe for Pub/Sub.
Full support for RESP2 and RESP3 protocols automatically.
Comprehensive JSON module support with type-safe repository stores.
weaknesses: Requires a running Valkey or Redis server instance for execution and integration testing.
data.setup_notes: Requires a running Valkey or Redis server instance accessible via host and port.
